set_aside.subject: ownership of opening the service API listener
set_aside.text: `instance_lifecycle` owns “the listeners at the release's addresses” and their opening order, while `service_api` owns “the service API's transport” and hides “The HTTP server of the service API”
set_aside.question: Which module owns binding, opening and closing the service API listening socket: `instance_lifecycle`, or `service_api` under lifecycle orchestration?
options: `instance_lifecycle` owns the sockets and passes an opened listener to `service_api`
`service_api` owns its socket and `instance_lifecycle` only tells it when to open and close
set_aside.default_guess: `instance_lifecycle` owns binding and closing both listeners; the surface modules handle requests on listeners supplied to them.
